title: Shortest Subarray With OR at Least K II
summary: Given an array of non-negative integers and an integer k, find the minimum length of a contiguous subarray whose bitwise OR of elements is at least k.
statement: Given an array of non-negative integers and an integer k, find the minimum length of a contiguous subarray whose bitwise OR of elements is at least k. If no such subarray exists, return -1.
constraints: nums contains nonnegative 32-bit integers and k is nonnegative.
Find a nonempty contiguous subarray whose bitwise OR is at least k.
Return its minimum length, or -1 if no qualifying subarray exists.
hints: OR is monotone when extending right, while per-bit counts make removing the left value reversible.
Maintain a sliding window, its OR, and counts of how many elements contribute each bit.
Add right bits; while OR≥k record length and remove left, clearing a bit only when its count reaches zero.
For each right endpoint, shrinking to the first invalid window yields its shortest valid suffix, and all candidate endpoints are considered.
